en.title: Cyclic Shift to Strictly Descending Array
en.description: Given an integer array nums and the right-rotation amount t for this run, move the last t elements to the front of the array once and determine whether the result is strictly decreasing. t is a given input value and does not need to be chosen.
en.input: The first line contains n (this site adopts the source's suggested range 1≤n≤200000), the second line contains n integers nums[i] (this site adopts the source's suggested range |nums[i]|≤10^9), and the third line contains t (this site adopts the source's suggested range 0≤t<n).
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Simulate in the order given by the statement, and watch the equality boundaries.
